label: Successful main route
description: The Vault Dweller returns a replacement water chip and removes both Unity production and command centres; order and method remain variable.

label: Overseer killed in the final scene
description: Optional player action after the Overseer exiles the Vault Dweller.

label: Shady Sands develops toward NCR
description: Ending branch in which Aradesh and Tandi survive and guide the settlement's growth.

label: Tandi leads Shady Sands
description: Ending branch in which Tandi survives while Aradesh does not.

label: Shady Sands destroyed
description: Failure branch in which leadership loss and raider pressure end the settlement.

label: Killian remains in control
description: Ending branch associated with Killian surviving the local power struggle.

label: Gizmo controls Junktown
description: Ending branch associated with Gizmo defeating Killian.

label: Junktown invaded by mutants
description: Failure branch caused by Unity's advance.

label: Necropolis loses its water supply
description: Ending branch in which the water system is not restored after removal of the chip.

label: Necropolis water restored
description: Ending branch in which the underground population survives after its pump is repaired.

label: Necropolis invaded by Unity
description: Failure branch in which mutant forces destroy the surviving ghoul population.

label: Khans destroyed
description: Ending branch in which the raider gang is eliminated.

label: Khans regroup
description: Ending branch in which surviving Khans rebuild their numbers.

label: Khans destroyed by mutants
description: Failure branch during Unity's expansion.

label: The Hub becomes more equal
description: Ending branch associated with humane treatment of Harold.

label: The Hub disperses
description: Failure branch during the mutant advance.

label: Followers survive and expand their influence
description: Ending branch in which the Followers survive the Cathedral conflict.

label: Followers destroyed
description: Failure branch during Unity's advance.

label: Brotherhood cautiously aids the wasteland
description: Favourable ending branch involving research and limited technological aid.

label: Steel Plague
description: Hostile ending branch in which the Brotherhood becomes a technological dictatorship.

label: Vault 13 water deadline expires
description: Failure state in which the water supply is exhausted before repair.

label: Unity discovers Vault 13
description: Failure state in which mutant forces locate and invade the Vault.

label: Master persuaded by sterility evidence
description: Optional resolution in which the Master accepts evidence that undermines Unity's plan.

label: Master triggers self-destruction
description: Optional consequence of the persuasion resolution.
